eyebrow.zh: 录一次 · 永久重放 · 改版自愈
eyebrow.en: Record once · Replay forever · Self-heals on change

headline.zh:
把一次浏览器走查
变成永远能重放的能力
headline.en:
Turn one browser walkthrough
into a capability you can replay forever

sub.zh: 录一次人工流程，结晶成参数化资产；站点改版时自动重定位，不再每次重新推理。
sub.en: Record a human flow once into a parameterized asset; it re-locates itself when the site changes — no re-inference every run.

body.zh: 人工走一遍流程，自动结晶成可复用资产；重放零推理调用，每次确定性跑通。
body.en: Walk through a flow once; it becomes a reusable asset. Replay makes zero inference calls — deterministic every time.

body.zh: selector 漂移时，用你自己的 LLM key 对实时 DOM 重定位，修好资产并继续；越用越稳。
body.en: When a selector drifts, it re-locates against the live DOM with your own LLM key, repairs the asset, and continues — it gets sturdier the more you use it.

body.zh: 本地 UI 把硬编码值改成 {{param}}，删多余步，声明参数；一份资产多人多账号复用。
body.en: A local UI turns hard-coded values into {{param}}, prunes steps, declares params — one asset, many accounts, many people.

title.zh: CI 里校验，资产即制品

body.zh: 不启浏览器、不调 LLM 即校验 .flow.json 结构与参数，无效则非零退出——把流程资产当一等制品管理。
body.en: Validate a .flow.json's structure and params with no browser and no LLM — non-zero exit on failure, so flows are first-class artifacts you can gate in CI.

headline.en: Record once. Stop re-inferring every run.

sub.zh: 把今天的演示，变成明天还能跑的能力。
sub.en: Turn today's demo into a capability that still runs tomorrow.

tag.zh: Apache-2.0 · 本地优先 · 你的 LLM key
tag.en: Apache-2.0 · Local-first · Your own LLM key
